validation_scope.archive_integrity: All regular archived files checked against per-file SHA-256 manifests
validation_scope.task_roster: All 300 task directories checked against the release roster
validation_scope.restoration: Complete Java archive restored with scripts/restore.py
validation_scope.download: Java release asset downloaded again and its SHA-256 verified
validation_scope.runtime: One reference task per backend/language; compilation and before/after scans in the distributed environment

limitations: Runtime smoke checks cover 5 representative tasks, not a new complete 300-task score evaluation.
Full CSA refinement replay is not covered by these before/after smoke checks.
